definitions.explanation: A substance ground or crushed into very fine particles. Used for medicines, food products, chemicals, and other materials in powdered form.

examples.japanese: {粉末|ふんまつ}にして⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧。
examples.english: Medicine that you take in powdered form.

examples.japanese: {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{粉末|ふんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧すりつぶして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please grind this material until it becomes a fine powder.

notes:
USAGE:
{粉末|ふんまつ} is a somewhat technical or formal word. In everyday speech, ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧ (powder) is more common. {粉末|ふんまつ} is preferred on product labels, in scientific contexts, and when specifying the form of a product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: in powdered form
- {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reduce to powder
- {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧: powdered detergent
- {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧: powdered soup
- {粉末|ふんまつ}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧: powdered tea

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧ is the everyday, casual word for powder. {粉末|ふんまつ} is more formal and specific, typically used for products and technical descriptions.

cross_references.label: powder (especially cosmetic or fine granular material)
